card.line: Mount Hor is a mountain near the border of Edom where Israel camped and where Aaron the priest died after the LORD told Moses to bring him up.

moments.title: Israel camps at Mount Hor
moments.text: After leaving Kadesh, the whole congregation of Israel came to Mount Hor, near the border of Edom. There the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.

moments.title: Aaron dies on the mountain
moments.text: Moses took Aaron and his son Eleazar up Mount Hor as the LORD commanded. Moses put Aaron's priestly garments on Eleazar, and Aaron died there on top of the mountain at 123 years old. Israel mourned for him thirty days.

moments.title: Israel leaves Mount Hor
moments.text: Israel set out from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea to go around the land of Edom. On the way the people grew impatient and spoke against God and Moses.
